title: Pay and Units Worked Domain
description: JSON Schema for the Pay and Units Worked domain

periodBeginDate.description: Beginning date of the reporting period

periodEndDate.description: Ending date of the reporting period

recordCount.description: Number of payAndUnitsWorked records in the file

uniqueIdentifier.description: Primary participant identifier; this could be the SSN or Employee Id to be determined by the project team.

sourceAssignmentId.description: An assignment key that identifies the job in case of employee having the same employee id across multiple job under the same employer

employerCode.description: Unique employer code that would be generated by BenefitsIQ; this code to be used by employer when they provide these files

lastName.description: This is member's (employee) last name to help with identifying employee's record; this does not get loaded;

firstName.description: This is member's (employee) fisrt name to help with identifying employee's record; this does not get loaded;

payDate.description: Indicates the date for which the current employer is submitting the report;

payPeriodBeginDate.description: Indicates the pay period begin date for which the employee is being reported

payPeriodEndDate.description: Indicates the pay period end date for which the employee is being reported

payUpdateType.description:
"OVERWRITE" indicates the record from the file is to overwrite a record in BIQ with the same pay date.
"ADJUSTMENT" indicates the record from the file is to load the record and not overwrite any existing record in BIQ with the same pay date.

For year-to-date value, "OVERWRITE" is expected.

payType.description:
Represents the pay type associated with an amount received for the given pay period.

See Pay Type section on "Emp Valid Values" sheet;

payAmount.description:
This value must correspond to the employer’s pay schedule and represents the frequency with which wages and contributions will be reported.

For available options, see Frequency section on "Emp Valid Values" sheet.

currency.description: Represents the currency associated with the pay amount.

unitsWorkedDate.description: Indicates the date for which the current employer is submitting the report

unitsWorkedPeriodBeginDate.description: Indicates the units worked period begin date for which the employee is being reported

unitsWorkedPeriodEndDate.description: Indicates the units worked period end date for which the employee is being reported

unitsWorkedUpdateType.description:
"OVERWRITE" indicates the record from the file is to overwrite a record in BIQ with the same pay date.
"ADJUSTMENT" indicates the record from the file is to load the record and not overwrite any existing record in BIQ with the same units worked date.

typeOfUnitsWorked.description: Represents the type of units worked by the employee. See "Emp Valid Values"

actualUnitsWorked.description: Represents the actual number of units worked by employee in this reporting period.

unitsCategory.description:
Represents the category of units worked by the employee.

For available options, see Units Worked Category section on "Emp Valid Values" sheet.

fullTimeUnits.description:
Represents the number of units employee would have to work to be considered a Full Time employee.

The frequency field indicates whether this value represents a weekly, bi-weekly, monthly and etc.

unitsToWorkFrequency.description:
This value must correspond to the employer’s pay schedule and represents the frequency with which wages and contributions will be reported.

For available options, see Frequency section on "Emp Valid Values" sheet.

allowanceType.description: This could be any available allowance provided by an employer. For example, for state of Kentucky, there's an allowance available to its employees for whiskey.

allowanceBalance.description: Represents the dollar amount for the associated allowance type.
